_comment: Canonical corridor registry (API_CONTRACTS.md Corridor, minus the fields the seed job derives: boundaryGeoJsonStorageUrl, monitoringStationIds, createdAt). IDs are the contract's CorridorId slugs -- every service, the dashboards and Terraform use these exact strings. GRAP thresholds are CAQM's revised GRAP (Stage I 201-300, II 301-400, III 401-450, IV >450). Corridors without an active GRAP framework omit thresholds; alert-service then falls back to CPCB National AQI bands.
